title: SketchScape GPU worker result
description: Two worker-token-authenticated callback shapes, chosen by job kind (backend/main.py ReconstructionJob.kind). `reconstruct` jobs (one selection's mask -> one PLY, unchanged since Build Plan step 26) use `WorkerResult` in the `result` form field of POST /v1/internal/reconstructions/{job_id}/result: multipart/form-data with `result` (this JSON), `worker_token`, optional `worker_id` (required when the job was claimed through the lease queue, i.e. POST /v1/internal/jobs/claim), and file parts `ply` (Gaussian-splat PLY) and `mask` (aligned binary PNG, white is the object) -- both required when status is complete -- `preview` (mask-preview PNG), and optional `pose` (pose.json v1/v2, <= 256 KB, docs/IMMERSIVE_SCENE_PIPELINE.md 1a; stored as artifacts/<job_id>/pose.json and inlined on the job, asset and asset view; an invalid pose is ignored, never fails the job). A photo's whole-scene capture goes to GET/POST /v1/internal/reconstructions/{job_id}/scene (contract section 2). `segment` jobs (Build Plan step 27: one SAM 3.1 pass over every selection's typed name) use `SelectionWorkerResult` once PER SELECTION in the `result` form field of POST /v1/internal/reconstructions/{job_id}/selections/{selection_id}/result: multipart/form-data with `result` (this JSON), `worker_token`, `worker_id` (required once the job was claimed -- every segment job goes through the lease queue), a `mask` file part (required when status is segmented), and an optional `preview` file part. The job completes once every one of its selections has reported a terminal (segmented/failed) outcome; a failed selection never blocks the others (Hard Rule 7). The job id and selection id are in the URL path, not in either payload.

score.description: The chosen instance's confidence from SAM 3.1's semantic predictor.

alternatives.description: Other instances the predictor found for this selection's text prompt (score, area_ratio), after the area and cross-selection duplicate filters. The person can see these were considered; switching to one is a future enhancement, not built by step 27.

reason.description: Why this selection is `failed` (empty result, area filter, or flagged as a duplicate of another selection in the same pass).
